item.description: ABSTRACT Background: Unobtrusive recognition of activities of daily living (ADLs) from ambient sensors may support longitudinal assessment of everyday functioning in adults with mild neurocognitive disorder (mild NCD). item.description: Abstract This study developed a data-driven decision-support framework to project annual hospital admissions and in-hospital mortality for ischemic heart disease (IHD) and cerebrovascular disease in Suriname from 2023 through 2050. item.description: Background: Human-centered design (HCD) is a co-creation approach that is increasingly being utilized by implementation science researchers to engage key stakeholders in developing contextually appropriate health interventions and implementation strategies. item.description: Objective: To evaluate the safety and efficacy of the Surpass Evolve flow diverter system for the treatment of intracranial aneurysms across three medical centers. item.description: Abstract Background: Ambient AI documentation reduces documentation burden and electronic health record (EHR) time for ambulatory clinicians. item.description: Background: Tuberculosis (TB) remains a major public health challenge in Cameroon, yet national evidence on treatment outcomes across the full spectrum of routine care is limited. item.description: Elevated plasma phosphorylated tau (p-tau) species are proposed as specific biomarkers of Alzheimer's disease (AD) pathology but have also been reported in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). item.description: Background Autonomic symptoms are common in Parkinson disease (PD) and impact quality of life, with unclear relationship to motor and cognitive progression.
